purpose: Switch second-pass work from repeated unit investigations to reusable backend/source-family resolution queues. Only evidenced backend relationships are persisted; unknown relationships remain unassigned.

queues.evidence: Targeted audits 003-005 recovered exact DE*738 EVSE identities and station-level price/fee records through chargecloud/Mobilithek-derived surfaces; first-party AUEW supplies the binding tariff-class matrix.
queues.resolutionMode: Reconcile exact EVSE identity -> site -> tariff zone/power class -> complete fee components. Do not infer class from nominal power alone because Johann-Althaus-Strasse demonstrates a mixed-power exception.
queues.next: Reconcile the residual six canonical Allgaeuer charge points against the expanded DE*738 matrix before any further broad discovery.

queues.evidence: GEW first-party identifies ChargePoint as operating partner and direct contactless card payment. Current Mobilithek/Eco-Movement-derived station records expose per-EVSE ad-hoc values and fee fields.
queues.resolutionMode: Map only GEW official locations/EVSEs; normalize source-net 0.44 EUR/kWh plus 19% VAT to the binding gross checkout representation only when semantics are explicit; verify start/blocking fields per official site.
queues.next: Finish Marktstrasse/Bahnhofstrasse and Valoisplatz fee/mapping confirmation; do not generalize unrelated ChargePoint sites.

queues.evidence: Greifswald first-party explicitly identifies charge it easy / Charge-IT as direct spontaneous charging without registration, paid by credit card, and says conditions are shown after selecting the charge point. Current Einbeck municipal/tourism pages document the same app and anonymous credit-card flow. Current Bad Kissingen first-party page documents charge it easy without prior registration and credit-card payment, while warning its numeric tariff sheet is still dated 2021 and Parkhaus Zentrum is temporarily unavailable. Current FAMILA station evidence identifies chargeIT mobility / charge it easy and station-level AC/DC direct values; FAMILA remains an identity/coverage reconciliation case, so those values are not generalized. The current app publisher is LichtBlick eMobility GmbH and the app still selects charge points by map/list/short-code and exposes stored authentication options.
queues.resolutionMode: Treat the app/backend as a shared dynamic-price family. Identify a public/guest/read-only direct-payment or app data surface once, validate on at least two independently proven operators, then expand only to additional CPOs whose Charge-IT/LichtBlick relationship is independently proven. Preserve station-level pricing and operator ownership.
queues.probeStatus: Public web search confirms current app ownership and direct-price display semantics but did not expose a stable documented public tariff API in this pass. Do not guess private endpoints from the mobile app.
queues.next: Inspect public Online-Direktbezahlung links, app-linked public APIs/bundles and QR URL shapes. If no guest tariff endpoint is exposed after two distinct evidence-led probes, park backend extraction and use Mobilithek/AFIR per-EVSE records for this family.

queues.evidence: Current first-party AGB states that spontaneous customers use ladenetz.de ladeapp and that each session has a base fee plus consumption-dependent charge, with current prices displayed in ladeapp before charging.
queues.resolutionMode: Resolve the live anonymous/ad-hoc base + energy price from the public/guest ladeapp/QR surface; keep the separate RFID/card tariff out of the anonymous layer.
queues.next: Capture current ladeapp/QR tariff for representative SWErft EVSEs, then test whether the same endpoint can cover the full 27-column cooperation estate deterministically.

queues.evidence: First-party becharged documents its own cloud/OCPP backend and Charge & Share public QR/PayPal charging product.
queues.resolutionMode: Because customer/site pricing is configurable, seek a public per-charge-point QR/checkout price surface; never create a network-wide becharged tariff.
queues.next: Identify public Charge & Share QR URL shape and test read-only tariff retrieval on a known public charge point.

queues.evidence: First-party smopi documentation exposes its own OCPP backend relationship and confirms CPO/backend operation; classification already established charge-point-specific pricing.
queues.resolutionMode: Search only for public/guest direct-payment tariff surfaces. OCPP broker configuration is infrastructure evidence, not authorization to access private backend functions.
queues.next: Identify public payment/QR frontend and determine whether numeric tariff can be retrieved without authentication.

queues.evidence: First-party FAQ explicitly directs the non-Hubject QR code to emobility.l.de/e-mobility-frontend/adhoc for anonymous ad-hoc charging.
queues.resolutionMode: Query only public frontend/guest resources to bind the 2026 ad-hoc tariff and enumerate post-2024 exceptions; never substitute registered L-Strom.drive 0.54/0.64 pricing.
queues.next: Bind post-2024 EVSEs to current ad-hoc 0.65 AC / 0.75 DC evidence and identify any site-specific fee exception before promotion.

safetyRules: no eMSP/roaming substitution for direct CPO price
no network-wide inference from site-configurable backends
two failed identical attempts without new evidence => park method and move on
nextSafeAction: Continue exact Allgaeuer reconciliation and run one evidence-led public Online-Direktbezahlung/QR probe for the expanded charge-it-easy family. In parallel discover additional independently proven CPO members so a successful method can be applied in bulk.
